PolyTears Beta

A downloadable game for Windows and macOS

Download NowName your own price

Try Red Tears: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389460/Red_Tears/
https://lionn00b.itch.io/red-tears-alpha-testing

PolyTears is an in-dev, single player sandbox open world FPS game inspired by the likes of Far Cry and S.T.A.L.K.E.R. with a low poly artstyle and many things to do in it, such as raiding enemy outposts for loot, participating in faction warfare, completing bounty missions, exploring, and hunting! 

Join the development discord for more updates on this game! https://discord.gg/SmgVbmX

Also check out this Document for more info about the future of this game: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IPwUfzoYN-H1GhX1pLzVRtKRcWA7GxnhQS90IoGV-_8/...

--Important Controls--
WASD, 1,2,3, F, R

Left Control - Cycle Healing

Q - Weapon Grid

Left Shift - Sprint or Steady ADS (while standing still)

C - Crouch or Slide (while sprinting)

All controls can be checked in the "Controls" option menu (no custom keybindings yet)

--Outposts--

Outposts are bases full of enemies which can be raided either stealthily or guns-blazing for loot such as ammo, medkits and money. Each outpost also has a loot crate providing the player with a new weapon.

In the Beta, there are 2 maps. Kathban Dunes & Nabati Valley

Kathban Dunes:

-Junkyard

-Temple

-Prison

-Oil Depot

-Airstrip

Nabati Valley:

-Storage Depot

-Plantation

-Fish Market

--Money & Rations--

Money & Rations are earned through hunting animals, killing enemies, looting outposts, winning a faction battle and eliminating bounty targets.

Money is used for all items in the game such as weapons, attachments, weapon repairs and the Scout For Hire.

Rations are used in the Reinforcement Kit to call in many useful assets. In the Beta the Reinforcements are:

-Friendly Squad Backup Spawn

-Supply Crate (Loot and access to Stash)

-Car Spawn

-Mortar Support

--Bounties--

Bounties are random missions placed around the map for the player to complete for rewards. 3 Bounties can be on the map at one time and can be referred to in the Bounty Board located in Hub areas, they can also be manually refreshed from the board or by sleeping. In the Beta the possible bounty missions are:

-Target Assassination in Outpost

-Loot Convoy

-Target Assassination in Convoy

-Destroy Antenna Tower

--Battlefield (0.9 and below only, replaced by Skirmish mode in beta)--

The Battlefield is a place on the map where two factions clash at all times. It is marked on the map with the red pulsing circle and winning the battle (killing most enemies) will yield rewards and move the Battlefield to a new location.
